anomaly_label: Increased distillate flow to distillate receiver (V003)

evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature reads 273.928 °C, far above the remaining column temperatures.
Temperature has risen monotonically to 278.499 °C (+4.571 °C), without a corresponding column-wide temperature rise; sensor drift is suspected but not confirmed.
Other temperatures remain near their initial values: T702 60.463 °C, T703 50.415 °C, T704 55.570 °C, T706 55.601 °C, T708 50.418 °C, T709 39.122 °C, T711 36.275 °C, T712 36.018 °C.
Pressure remains near 500 mbar (500.431); differential pressures are 1.116 and 1.780 mbar, with no sustained pressure rise across the observations; both level switches remain 1.

args.missing_evidence: Independent reboiler temperature measurement and T701 calibration check to distinguish thermocouple drift from actual heating; protocol temperature limits, heater settings and mixture identity to evaluate the thermal discrepancy; composition analysis and target specification to assess separation. Reflux and distillate flow sensors are not installed.
